title: 'No mental capacity to react': Flydubai pilot Smit Machchhar's wife recalls shock
content: Sonal Machchhar faced an emotional turmoil upon discovering her husband Captain Smit Machchhar's heroic efforts during an airborne incident on a flydubai flight. Initially overwhelmed by the news, she found solace after visiting him in the hospital, reassured by his professional handling of the attack and the safety he ensured for the passengers. The incident has sparked an ongoing investigation involving both Israeli and UAE authorities.

title: IPL retentions: 'Unhappy' Abhishek Sharma wants to leave SRH
content: Abhishek Sharma's future at Sunrisers Hyderabad is in focus ahead of the IPL retention deadline, with the opener "unhappy" after Ishan Kishan was handed the captaincy last year and is set to continue in IPL 2027 as well because of Pat Cummins, who is likely to cut down on his franchise commitments. Mumbai Indians, Gujarat Titans and Punjab Kings are among potential destinations, while Delhi Capitals could also emerge as an option for the star batter.

title: Elon Musk's 2010 solar gift to an Alabama disaster centre came with a message on oil
content: Elon Musk funded a 25-kilowatt solar project to help a community center in Coden, Alabama. The project was designed to provide electricity during emergencies, ensuring energy safety after disasters. It was installed at the South Bay Communities Alliance Hurricane Response Center, which aided recovery from Hurricane Katrina. SolarCity contributed to the installation and supported Musk's vision for energy independence.

title: Kevin O’Leary-backed Utah AI data center plan downsized after local backlash
content: Kevin O’Leary-backed plans for a 40,000-acre AI data centre district in Utah have been cut to about 20,000 acres after strong local opposition. Residents have raised concerns over the project’s energy and water use, environmental impact and public review. Developers say the project could create thousands of jobs and support US computing and national defence.

title: 'All chasing CM’s chair’: BJP accuses Congress of infighting after Warring’s resignation
content: Amarinder Singh Raja Warring has suggested his removal from the Punjab Congress chief post is imminent. Internal divisions have prompted calls for leadership change ahead of the 2027 assembly elections. Warring expressed satisfaction with his tenure, despite challenges and differences within the party. Several candidates are being considered to replace him in the upcoming announcement. The party high command will make the final decision on the new leadership.

title: Historic milestone: Watch Vande Bharat cross Chenab bridge, Anji bridges at 100 kmph
content: The higher speed of 100 kmph was successfully put to the test today, according to Railway minister Ashwini Vaishnaw. Vande Bharat Express (Train No. 26401/26404) set a new record by traversing the world's highest railway bridge, Chenab Bridge, and India's first cable-stayed railway bridge, the Anji Khad Bridge at 100 kmph.

title: Motivational quote of the Day by Michael B Jordan
content: Michael B. Jordan is optimistic about 2026 and aims for personal development by surpassing his past self. He emphasizes the importance of making small yet impactful changes to foster self-growth. Jordan's encouragement inspires people to relish their unique journeys instead of measuring their success against others on social media, advocating that gradual efforts lead to significant transformations.

title: Utah man built backyard railroad with 40,000 pounds of gravel and $18,000 budget
content: Cory Mohl from West Valley City has constructed a remarkable backyard railroad project, aiming to share his love for trains with the community. He dedicated significant time and resources to build around 400 feet of track, attracting local children who delight in riding the miniature train. This charming setup has become a beloved neighborhood fixture, encouraging connections among residents.

title: Illinois man built underground ‘caveman’ home in 1977; now listed for $59,000
content: An underground house located in Armington, Illinois, is currently on the market for $59,000. Built in the 1970s, the home features unique rock-lined interiors and circular windows. While the home offers significant size, much of the interior remains unfinished and requires renovation. Buyers should consider potential renovation costs alongside the low asking price per square foot. This property has potential for various uses, including a vacation home or rental.

title: Utah removes 17 million tons of radioactive waste from beside Colorado River
content: The Moab Uranium Mill Tailings Remedial Action Project has efficiently relocated 17 million tons of waste from the riverbank. Following rail transportation, teams are actively monitoring groundwater contamination levels. Upcoming efforts will also involve excavating contaminated soil near the original tailings site. The objective is to guarantee long-term safety and stability for local residents and the ecosystem. Ultimately, regrading and revegetating the area will be crucial in preventing future erosion.

title: Will Russian oil be economically viable for India if Trump tariffs return?
content: Russia became an unusually attractive supplier when Western buyers retreated after the war with Ukraine. Its share of Indian crude imports, below 2% before the war, expanded rapidly as discounts compensated refiners for longer supply chains. In the present day, the situation has become more complex, the new US law potentially changes the economics of India’s Russian oil purchases.

title: Josh Brolin bought Georgia estate for $3.25m; later sold it for $4 million
content: Josh Brolin sold his Sandy Springs estate for $4 million, after initially listing it at nearly $5 million. The home features seven bedrooms and traditional design elements that appeal to potential buyers in the area. Brolin and his wife originally purchased the property for $3.25 million in 2020 and considered renting it out at first. The sale aligns with their recent move to California following Brolin's film work in Atlanta.

title: Michigan’s $3.2bn Soo Locks project reaches halfway mark in final phase
content: Michigan's Soo Locks project has achieved 50% completion and is on track for a 2030 finish. This $3.219 billion project began in 2020 and includes multiple construction phases. The final construction phase involves extensive work including cofferdam construction and demolition of the existing Sabin Lock. Crews are currently focused on concrete placement, with significant amounts already completed. This project is expected to enhance commercial navigation and support thousands of jobs.

title: Neeru Dhanda flies back to Japan within a day to be India's flag bearer at Asian Games closing ceremony
content: Neeru Dhanda’s Asian Games campaign was already one to remember, with the Indian shooter returning from Aichi-Nagoya with 2 gold medals and a silver despite battling viral fever. A day after reaching home in Jind, Neeru received another call - this time informing her that she had been chosen as India’s women’s flag bearer for the closing ceremony.

title: Dino Morea arrested by EOW in Mithi River desilting case
content: Dino Morea was arrested by Mumbai Police's Economic Offences Wing after a lengthy questioning session. His arrest is linked to the alleged Mithi River desilting scam involving financial irregularities. The BMC reportedly suffered a loss of Rs 65.54 crore from contracts awarded for the river's rejuvenation. Morea had previously been questioned in May 2025 regarding phone records connecting him to the investigation.

title: Rafale, F-15EX & Gripen: Why 4th gen jets are bagging billion-dollar orders in age of 6th-gen
content: Nations are increasingly ordering fourth- and 4.5-generation fighters as they are cost-effective and readily available. France's Rafale and the US F-15EX are prominent examples of this trend. Various countries, including Ukraine and Colombia, have made commitments to acquire these aircraft. Fourth-generation fighters remain effective with capabilities that complement fifth-generation fighters. Their operational advantages indicate that they will continue to play a significant role in air forces.

title: 'Better to die with self-respect': Ex-maharaja of Bharatpur Vishvendra Singh quits Cong
content: Vishvendra Singh announced his departure from Congress after expressing dissatisfaction with party leadership and election outcomes. He accused local Congress leaders of poor performance in recent urban local body elections. Singh emphasized his commitment to truth and self-respect over party loyalty amid ongoing disagreements within the party. State party president Govind Singh Dotasra dismissed claims of discord, attributing them to BJP propaganda.

title: New Jersey homebuyer gets $575K home for $545K, saves $350 a month with incentives
content: A New Jersey homebuyer viewed 10 older houses but rejected them after finding costly repairs and maintenance would add to their purchase price. He then considered a new townhouse in Pennsylvania listed at $575,000. After negotiations, he bought it for $545,000 and secured $30,000 in builder incentives, including a mortgage-rate buydown that reduced his rate from 6.25% to 5.25%.

title: Melting Norway ice reveals 48 prehistoric arrows up to 6,000 years old
content: In a remarkable discovery, Norwegian archaeologists are uncovering ancient treasures as glaciers shrink, revealing 48 prehistoric arrows, including one dated between 5,000 and 6,000 years. This influx of artefacts signifies a shift in our understanding of prehistoric activities as ice melts in the region. The urgency of recovery efforts underscores the impending deterioration of these valuable pieces, highlighting the rapid loss of ice cover around the world.

title: Paid for 10 weight-loss sessions, attended 4: Woman wins Rs 86,200 from clinic
content: A consumer commission in Tamil Nadu ruled in favor of a woman regarding her cryotherapy package complaint. She received a refund of Rs 51,200 and compensation for mental distress. The commission found the clinic deficient in service without sufficient treatment documentation. Although some complaints were not upheld, the clinic's failure to provide services warranted the refund. The clinic must pay the amounts within 45 days or face interest penalties.

title: 'BSP is my family': Akash Anand's fresh appeal to Mayawati after party exit
content: Akash Anand declared his commitment to the Bahujan Samaj Party while addressing his recent political challenges. After being removed from his position, he expressed his dedication to the party and Mayawati's leadership. Anand supported Mayawati's decision regarding his father-in-law's retirement from politics. He explained his silence on social media that was misinterpreted as disloyalty and offered an apology.

title: The midnight rescue of Karachi's Mahatma Gandhi
content: As communal riots raged in 1948, a young Parsi and his friends secretly spirited away a life-size bronze Gandhi statue. Former Indian diplomat G Parthasarathy recounts how one of Pakistan's only two Bapu statues survived.

title: ‘My wife is ill, I want to sleep with you’: UP school operator's video goes viral
content: Dinesh Rai, a private school operator in Kushinagar, was arrested due to a viral video. The video showed him making inappropriate comments to a female staff member. Rai allegedly suggested a physical relationship while referencing personal issues. Following the video's circulation, police registered a case against him under various sections of the law. Further legal action will be determined based on ongoing investigations and available evidence.

title: Martha Stewart bought 63-acre Maine estate for under $6m, restored historic home
content: In 1997, Martha Stewart took over the Skylands estate, diligently preserving its historic architecture and the stunning landscape, initially crafted by Jens Jensen. This remarkable property, once owned by Edsel Ford, encapsulates pivotal elements of American architectural history connected to the Ford lineage. With the help of landscape architect Patrick Chassé, Stewart revitalized the estate’s gardens to harmonize with the natural environment.

title: Three golds in a day! Ankush completes Indian boxing hat-trick at Asian Games
content: Ankush Panghal secured the gold medal in the men's 80kg final against South Korea's Minseong Kim. This victory came after Lovlina Borgohain and Parveen Hooda won their respective finals in women's categories. Lovlina celebrated her birthday with a significant win against China's Ziyi Bao, becoming a two-time Asian Games champion. Parveen earned her first Asian Games gold in a tightly contested match against Chen Nien-chin of Chinese Taipei.

title: 'I am not done yet': Yuzvendra Chahal announces retirement
content: India leg-spinner Yuzvendra Chahal on Friday announced his retirement from first-class cricket, bringing an end to his red-ball career after 17 years. Chahal said his dream of playing Test cricket may not be fulfilled, but he remains determined to continue playing white-ball cricket for India.

title: Sujeet Kalkal wins India's first wrestling gold at Asian Games 2026
content: Sujeet Kalkal gave India its first gold medal in wrestling at the Asian Games 2026, winning the men's freestyle 65kg title in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan. Kalkal defeated Tajikistan's Abdulmazhid Kudiev in the final at the Nagoya City Inae Sports Center.

title: ‘Don’t cut salaries’: Govt’s clear directive to companies as EPF wage ceiling rises
content: On September 17, the government increased the EPFO wage threshold from Rs 15,000 to Rs 25,000. The revision is expected to extend mandatory coverage to more than 10 million additional workers and give another push to workforce formalisation. In the frequently asked questions released on the matter, the ministry acknowledged that the revised wage ceiling would inevitably raise employers' costs.

title: ‘People will come running’: CJP’s Saurav Das on Delhi Metro station closures

In light of security concerns at Jantar Mantar, twelve Delhi Metro stations' entry and exit gates have been shut down. Despite these restrictions, protesters are anticipated to make their voices heard, according to CJP spokesperson Saurav Das.

Marking the launch on Gandhi Jayanti, Vijay travelled by bus in Chennai and interacted with passengers. The scheme removed previous limitations on the types of bus services available for free travel. It aims to enhance economic empowerment and education opportunities without transportation costs hindering access.

title: ‘Sigma’ BO day 1: Jason Sanjay-Sundeep Kishan starrer begins its theatrical run

This thrilling heist drama, starring Sundeep Kishan, has drawn a mix of enthusiastic and lukewarm reactions from audiences. With an opening day box office earning of approximately Rs. 1.08 crore, many praised Kishan's acting, although some viewers found the plot to be somewhat predictable. The film released in both Tamil and Telugu languages, boosting its overall earnings.

content: Fears about a severe El Nino weather pattern have pushed international sugar prices to an 18-month high, while a war-related collapse in Black Sea trade pushed wheat futures to a three-year peak early last month.

title: 'Just Undo It' : How Nike Lost Its Swoosh And $230 Billion
content: Nike Sportswear, which includes many of its biggest everyday shoes and apparel, has been particularly weak. Jordan Brand is also struggling.

title: How Congress Leader's Resignation Threat Exposed Rajasthan Leadership Rift
content: In Vishvendra's home district of Bharatpur, sources say the district presidents of Deeg and Bharatpur districts had the upper hand in giving tickets.

title: 3rd Aircraft Carrier, 10,000 Troops Head To Middle East After Trump's Warning
content: The USS Theodore Roosevelt and its strike group carrying the service members would arrive in the Middle East by the end of November. Currently two other aircraft carriers are stationed in the region -- the USS George HW Bush and the USS George Washington.

title: Tribal Minister, 20-Crore Plot, And A "General" Entry Row In Chhattisgarh
content: Chhattisgarh Minister Kedar Kashyap belongs to the Scheduled Tribe community. Yet, according to the documents being questioned, the category "General" appears in connection with the landholding.

title: 'Raja ki chutti karni chahiye': Warring resigns after meeting Rahul, blames Pilot
content: amarinder Singh Raja Warring formally resigns as the PPCC chief . he gave over his resignation to Rahul Gandhi amid reports of a leadership change ahead of the 2027 assembly elections . Warring led the state Congress for around four-and-a-half years .

title: For Kolkata’s football fans, Brazil was love before first sight
content: the city host Vini Jr & Co for tomorrow’s friendly at salt lake stadium . the city holds a special place for Brazil, a love affair that began with its first breakout stars . it is set to only deepen when Vinicius Jr and his teammates arrive for the friendly they play against India .

title: Dubai calls, Rs 1cr demand, planned firing: Goldy Brar-linked extortion racket busted
content: three alleged operatives arrested as police uncovered threats to two businessmen and a suspected plan to open fire at a businessman's residence . the accused allegedly contacted businessman Praveen Jain through a UAE-based number on September 16 and demanded Rs 1 crore, while threatening his family with dire consequences .

title: Burmese python mothers shiver to heat their eggs in wild Florida nest
content: the female can play an active role in controlling the temperature inside the nest . when conditions become too cool, muscles along her body begin contracting rapidly, producing heat that raises her own temperature and helps warm the eggs . temperatures loggers placed around the nest recorded changes in the conditions surrounding the female .

title: Gujarat UCC Bill gets President Murmu’s nod paving way for implementation
content: president Murmu gives assent to the Gujarat UCC Bill, 2026 . the state becomes second in India after Uttarakhand to pass a Uniform Civil Code . but the provisions of the bill will not apply to members of Scheduled Tribes .

title: 'Comrades, return to Jantar Mantar': Neha tells protesters to not be intimidated

title: 'Terrorist act': UAE official on flydubai attack, praises India pilot Smit Machchhar
content: the mid-air incident involved an alleged attack by his co-pilot . pilot Smit Machchhar was injured but managed to open the cockpit door . three Israeli passengers reportedly helped subdue the attacker . two additional pilots onboard took control of the aircraft and landed it safely in Saudi Arabia .

title: France rocked by protests as nearly 400 schools close amid student-police clashes
content: around 400 schools and other educational establishments remain closed following days of student protests in france . the protests have increasingly turned violent, with dozens of people injured and around 2,000 people taken into police custody since the unrest began . justice minister: "we're not entirely sure that they are even high-school students themselves"

title: Renee Good shooting: Family sues ICE agent, top Trump officials over her death
content: the family of Renee Good, 37, has filed two civil lawsuits against the us government, the agent, and several Trump administration officials . the lawsuits allege wrongful death, excessive use of force, conspiracy and other violations . one suit names the US government under the federal Tort Claims Act, while the second names ICE agent Jonathan Ross, several unnamed federal agents .

title: 'Exceptional courage': Pilots body seeks bravery award for Smit Machchhar, writes to PM
content: captain Smit Machchhar was reportedly attacked by the pilot-in-command of flydubai flight . he sustained serious injuries during the mid-air emergency on september 30 . the pilots' body seeks an appropriate national bravery award for captain .
